name: Pitch
summary: Collaborative presentation platform for creating, sharing and presenting decks, with AI generation.
description: Pitch is a presentation tool for teams. Users generate decks from prompts, edit them together in real time, share links with analytics and present. The Free plan covers one to five members; Plus costs $13 per seat per month paid yearly with 500 AI credits per seat, Team $19 and Business $25 per seat per month. The company states that more than four million teams use it.
